responsibility: Implements conversion of XML-encoded diagnostic state snapshots into GraphViz .dot graphs. It walks the XML state document structure for memory regions, stack frames, variables, fields, elements, and pointer/value nodes, constructs dot subgraphs and HTML-table nodes, records region ports and pending edges, and applies styling such as dynamic-allocation-state coloring for unchecked or freed heap buffers. The result is the dot::graph representation used by HTML diagnostics to show analyzer-style state diagrams.
